verdict.rationale: vLLM's official docs explicitly list support for FP8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, and other quantization schemes (vllm-docs-4), with further detail on backend overrides per scheme (vllm-docs-22, vllm-docs-23) and even custom quantization registration (vllm-docs-30). A single older community comment claims 4-bit wasn't supported (vllm-comm-1), but this appears to predate later doc-confirmed quantization support and isn't a concrete contemporary contradiction. missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks confirming current GPTQ/AWQ/FP8 loading works as documented, rather than relying solely on first-party docs.
